seo.title: Software suite
seo.seo_title: AI software suite: five names, five states
seo.seo_description: WorkStudio is delivered, as a demonstration on request; Nexora Code, Corpus, Quanta and Helix have no announced date. An AI software suite with honest states.

blocks.role: Promesse de la suite : une idée commune, l'état réel de chaque nom.

translation.headline: A suite, not a pile.
translation.subheadline: One idea ties Nexora AI's products together: AI that works for you, under your control, with the access, budgets and logs you manage. One name is already delivered, at the leading edge of AI; for the others, here is the real state of each.

translation.title: Five names, five states.
translation.intro: Only one of these five names is a delivered product. For the other four, we write what we know and nothing more.

cards.title: Nexora WorkStudio.
cards.text: The studio where you design, connect and run agents and workflows, in plain language and without writing code. Demonstration on request.

cards.title: Nexora Code.
cards.text: For development, code understanding, testing and maintenance assisted by agents. No availability or date is announced at this stage.

cards.title: Nexora Corpus.
cards.text: For preparing your documents and data. No availability or date is announced at this stage.

cards.title: Quanta.
cards.text: A model name. No availability or date is announced at this stage.

cards.title: Helix.
cards.text: A model name. No availability or date is announced at this stage.

blocks.role: Ce qui fait la cohérence d'une suite : mêmes règles d'accès, de budget, de validation et de données (déjà appliquées dans WorkStudio).

translation.title: What ties the suite together.
translation.body:
What makes a suite is not the number of names: it is the same way of working everywhere. WorkStudio already applies it; it serves as the rule for the suite.

Read the five commitments on your data.

Request a WorkStudio demonstration.

items.title: Access you manage.
items.text: Organizations, roles and an audit log: you know who does what.

items.title: Budgets you set.
items.text: Monthly consumption caps, by model, workspace and person.

items.title: A person who decides.
items.text: A step can wait for a person's approval before acting.

items.title: Data that stays yours.
items.text: Never used to train a model, never sold.

blocks.role: Nexora Corpus : la vocation, deux destinations distinctes.

translation.title: Corpus: two distinct destinations.
translation.body:
Nexora Corpus is meant to turn assorted files into cleaner, structured, traceable, usable data. What we describe here is an intention, not a delivered product.

It will distinguish two destinations that must not be confused: updating a document base and training a model are two different operations, with distinct costs, risks and approvals.

items.title: Knowledge for retrieval.
items.text: Extraction, classification, deduplication, access rights, provenance, versions, indexing: what it takes to find an answer in your documents, with its sources.

items.title: Data to specialize your own model.
items.text: Selection, quality, authorizations, usage rights, separation between training and evaluation, regression control.

items.title: A starting rule.
items.text: An imported document does not authorize its use for training. No data goes automatically to both destinations, and Nexora AI never uses your data to train or fine-tune a model, except your own, at your written request.

blocks.role: Nexora Code : la vocation, sans autonomie annoncée.

translation.title: Code: the purpose, nothing more.
translation.body:
Nexora Code is intended for agent-assisted development: understanding existing code, writing and running tests, easing maintenance, drawing on the organization's projects and knowledge.

We announce no universal autonomy, no number of agents working together and no schedule: none of this has been demonstrated to date.

blocks.role: Quanta et Helix : ce que nous ne publions pas.

translation.title: Quanta and Helix: what we leave out.
translation.intro: These are model names. Until their canonical sheets exist, we publish nothing that is not established.

cards.title: No size.
cards.text: We do not publish the number of parameters.

cards.title: No performance and no ranking.
cards.text: No result is presented as measured until it is.

cards.title: No claimed provenance.
cards.text: Provenance of the base models, licence and deployment terms will be published with the sheets, not before.

cards.title: No announced availability.
cards.text: No date and no availability promise at this stage.

items.question: Can I buy Nexora Code or Nexora Corpus?
items.answer: Not today: no availability or date is announced. As soon as a product exists, this page will say so.

items.question: Are Quanta or Helix better than other models?
items.answer: We publish no comparison. These models do not yet have a canonical sheet with measured results.

items.question: Will Corpus train a model on my documents?
items.answer: No, never. Importing a document into a knowledge base does not authorize its use for training, and Nexora AI never uses your data to train or fine-tune a model, except your own, at your written request.

items.question: What can I use right now?
items.answer: Nexora WorkStudio, on request. For construction and field services, OPSYS-AI, a product in development, with the availability level of each of its departments.

translation.title: Let's start with what exists.
translation.text: Nexora WorkStudio is presented as a demonstration on request; no self-service offer is open. OPSYS-AI covers construction as a product in development, with an honest level for each department.
